# GetHostAddress

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetHostAddress:String host_index:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host_index` | In | Int32 | required | The address to take, counting from 1. |

**Returns:** One of the addresses found by the last [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses), as text, or an empty string when there is none.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* Without a call of [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses) the addresses of this computer are used. Not in the original, which only knows IPv4 ([HostIP](HostIP)). See [IPv6](IPv6).
